# Weekday-shape note

All five Monday–Friday Google Maps Popular Times screenshots are now observed. Their within-day normalised profiles are strongly similar: morning activity rises sharply to a 07:00–08:00 peak, falls to a broad but non-zero midday plateau, then rises again to a stronger 17:00–19:00 peak before declining gradually after 20:00.

The derived `weekday_mean_profile.csv` is intentionally a shape summary only. It does not imply cross-day comparability in absolute station use and must not be treated as passenger counts, bus demand, OD demand, or a hard timetable-selection criterion.

Its appropriate use in RT031 is as an external temporal plausibility check when comparing service envelopes with the same or similar annual bus-km, especially uniform H30/10h versus longer daily spans combining H30 peak periods with H60 off-peak service.
